verdict.rationale: Perplexity ships an official MCP server, hosted remotely at api.perplexity.ai/mcp or run locally over stdio. It exposes search and reasoning as ready-made tools for agents, with per-tool enable/disable controls and use through the Anthropic Messages MCP connector. A CLI returning JSON for agent tool calls, typed SDKs and a published OpenAPI spec back this up. Missing for 10: explicit function-calling schema definitions (e.g., OpenAI tool JSON) for direct tool-call use, documented integrations with named agent frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and independent hands-on corroboration.
